text:
maria: doing a dry-run of the EU telemetry backfill for agg-hours, low scale but noticed a KV cache storm around shard-17 after ~30m :thinking_face:

sandeep: thanks for flagging — is that from duplicate replay keys or a hot-tenant pattern?

maria: looks like a hot-tenant plus overlapping replay windows. some keys get replayed across two replayers when we hit the shard boundary.

ashley: can we try a quick simulate with the --stagger flag and strict dedupe enabled? iirc we added a dedupe window option to the replayer last month.

maria: setup command i used:
```
./replayer --start=2026-03-10 --end=2026-03-12 --cohort=eu-agg --concurrency=8
```
will re-run with:
```
./replayer --start=2026-03-10 --end=2026-03-12 --cohort=eu-agg --concurrency=6 --stagger=600 --dedupe-window=3600
```

tom: the routing policy might also be amplifying this — shard affinity currently routes by tenant hash but when a node goes OOM we fallback to random which spreads the same hot keys. consider adding 'sticky fallback' to avoid bouncing the same key across nodes.

jules: sticky fallback would help short-term but we should limit fallback randomness to the preemptible pool, not the primary rack. otherwise latency SLOs suffer.

ashley: agreed. how about: primary routing -> sticky fallback within same AZ -> if capacity still full -> preemptible lane. that keeps hot keys localized.

sandeep: capacity wise, we could also throttle per-tenant token emit during replay. console can show a "replay throttle" slider for ops to dial global throttle 0-100%. UX note: keep it on the replay run page, not the global quota page.

maria: +1 on a quick UX; for now i'll run the staggered/dedupe dry-run and report numbers. ops-bot will post the job.

ops-bot: job 2026-03-07-3344129999 started: replayer (cohort=eu-agg, nodes=6, stagger=600, dedupe=3600)

maria: initial results after 25m: 40% drop in duplicate writes, peak KV cache evictions down 30%. tail latency unchanged for non-hot tenants.

jules: nice. can you paste the small flamegraph? if evictions still high on shard-17 we should adjust policy to pre-filter hot-tenants into a separate spillover queue.

maria: attaching snippet from the profiler (paste):
```
shard-17: cpu 12% -> 22% during overlap
kv-evict-rate: 420/s -> 290/s
write-retries: 12 -> 3
```

tom: that suggests dedupe + stagger fixed the rewrite amplification. next step: test the sticky-fallback sim and the console throttle control.

ashley: i'll mock up a quick throttle knob in the console (display only) so we can validate ops flow before we wire control. planning to push a preview by EOD.

maria: ok will re-run with sticky-fallback enabled once ashley posts the preview. last ask: can we add a small warning in the replayer run modal: "hot-tenant risk: shard-17 detected" so operators know to monitor KV cache.

sandeep: good call — add a link to the replayer trace and a preflight checklist: verify dedupe=true, stagger>=300, throttles set.

maria: thanks all, i'll update the runbook with the checklist and post follow-up results here in ~2h. :thumbsup:
